                        ( p. 800 ) शेप śēpa f ए ( سونف H) Anise-seed, Pimpinella anisum or Anethum sowa. 2) शेप, शेंप śēpa, śēmpa
                        ( p. 800 ) शेप śēpa , शेंप śēmpa f ई or ए A tail. 3) शेपकिडा, शेंपकिडा śēpakiḍā, śēmpakiḍā
                        ( p. 800 ) शेपकिडा śēpakiḍā , शेंपकिडा śēmpakiḍā m A worm having something resembling a tail, and wanting legs. It glides along like a snake. 4) शेपखळी, शेंपखळी śēpakhaḷī, śēmpakhaḷī
                        ( p. 800 ) शेपखळी śēpakhaḷī , शेंपखळी śēmpakhaḷī f The depression which forms on each side of the rump of a female beast when she is about to bring forth, the parting of the free bones . 5) शेपट śēpaṭa
                        ( p. 800 ) शेपट śēpaṭa a ( शेप ) That smells of A nise-seed. 6) शेपट śēpaṭa
                        ( p. 800 ) शेपट śēpaṭa f ( शेप ) Following hard at the tail of; driving vehemently and chasing (a beast). v काढ g. of o. 7) शेपटणें śēpaṭaṇēm
                        ( p. 800 ) शेपटणें śēpaṭaṇēm v c ( शेपटी Switch.) To switch. 8) शेपटणें, शेंपटणें śēpaṭaṇēm, śēmpaṭaṇēm
                        ( p. 800 ) शेपटणें śēpaṭaṇēm , शेंपटणें śēmpaṭaṇēm v c ( शेपट ) To follow hard at the tail of; to drive on and pursue violently (a beast). 9) शेपटा, शेंपटा, शेंपडा śēpaṭā, śēmpaṭā, śēmpaḍā
                        ( p. 800 ) शेपटा śēpaṭā , शेंपटा śēmpaṭā , शेंपडा śēmpaḍā m (Enhancing form of शेपूट Tail.) An extraordinarily large tail, a monster-tail. 10) शेपटी śēpaṭī
                        ( p. 800 ) शेपटी śēpaṭī f (Commonly शिपटी ) A switch. 11) शेपटी, शेंपटी, शेंपडी, शेंपुडी śēpaṭī, śēmpaṭī, śēmpaḍī, śēmpuḍī
                        ( p. 800 ) शेपटी śēpaṭī , शेंपटी śēmpaṭī , शेंपडी śēmpaḍī , शेंपुडी śēmpuḍī f ( शेपूट ) A tail. 2 (By synecdoche, as, in English, Head.) An individual (of bullocks and similar beasts). 12) शेपरणें, शेपारणें śēparaṇēm, śēpāraṇēm
                        ( p. 800 ) शेपरणें śēparaṇēm , शेपारणें śēpāraṇēm v i (Usually शेफरणें . Yet perhaps from शेप Tail. To cock the tail as in animal heat.) To be puffed up (disdainfully). 13) शेपळा śēpaḷā
                        ( p. 800 ) शेपळा śēpaḷā m A kind of worm. 2 Applied, hyperbolically, to a large louse; a louse like a शेपळा . 14) शेपा, शेप्या śēpā, śēpyā
                        ( p. 800 ) शेपा śēpā , शेप्या śēpyā a ( शेप ) Smelling of Anise-seed—a mango &c. 2 Epithet of a kind of rice. 15) शेपाटणें śēpāṭaṇēm
                        ( p. 800 ) शेपाटणें śēpāṭaṇēm v c ( शेपटी ) To switch. 16) शेपाळणें śēpāḷaṇēm
                        ( p. 800 ) शेपाळणें śēpāḷaṇēm v c ( शेप ) To twist the tail (of a bullock, in order to urge him on). Hence To pommel or belabour: also to abuse or scold violently. 17) शेपाळा, शेपाळ्या śēpāḷā, śēpāḷyā
                        ( p. 800 ) शेपाळा śēpāḷā , शेपाळ्या śēpāḷyā a ( शेप Tail.) In cant phrase. Libidinous, lascivious, lewd. 18) शेपाळू śēpāḷū
                        ( p. 801 ) शेपाळू śēpāḷū f ( शेप Tail.) In cant phrase. A female lecher, a wanton. 19) शेपू śēpū
                        ( p. 801 ) शेपू śēpū f ( शतपुष्पा S) A plant, Pimpinella anisum, or Anethum grave olens. Marsh. 20) शेपूट, शेंपूट śēpūṭa, śēmpūṭa
                        ( p. 801 ) शेपूट śēpūṭa , शेंपूट śēmpūṭa n ( शेप ) A tail. 2 fig. Extremity or end; the concluding or a supplemental portion. शे॰ अडकणें g. of s. To stick fast behind; to remain as inextricable, or as unmanageable or unaccomplishable;—used of an object fixed in some embarrassment or of an undertaking hard of consummation. शे॰ घालणें To run or sneak away cowardly or meanly. शे॰ ठेवणें To leave a small remnant (of a business, work, or thing); and शे॰ राहणें To be left or to remain. शे॰ लांबविणें To protract or prolong indefinitely (a work, a demand). शे॰ हालविणें To be libidinous;—used of the female. 21) शेपूटकल्याणी śēpūṭakalyāṇī
                        ( p. 801 ) शेपूटकल्याणी śēpūṭakalyāṇī f A cant formation for a lecherous woman. 22) शेपूटमोड्या śēpūṭamōḍyā
                        ( p. 801 ) शेपूटमोड्या śēpūṭamōḍyā a ( शेपूट & मोडणें ) That requires his tail to be twisted before he will move;—used of a starveling of a bullock. Hence A clodpate or dullard incapable of or indisposed for whatever service or work. 23) शेप्याघुडा, शेप्याघुड्या śēpyāghuḍā, śēpyāghuḍyā
                        ( p. 801 ) शेप्याघुडा śēpyāghuḍā , शेप्याघुड्या śēpyāghuḍyā a Epithet expressing a variety of the kind of rice called घुडा or ड्या . Search Form • DDSA Close
